claims.text: Rep. Burlison announced at the forum that MIT Lincoln Laboratory had agreed to make available a 1952 UFO briefing recording.
Held 25 June 2026, sponsored by the Disclosure Foundation, billed as a first-of-its-kind gathering of lawmakers, UAP researchers and whistleblowers.

By 25 June 2026 Lincoln Laboratory had agreed to make the material available; the Disclosure Foundation describes it as a reel-to-reel audio recording relating to the July 1952 Washington sightings and says Lincoln Lab's lawyers confirm it exists.
